title: Ender Eye Disabler
description: Disables using the ender eye whilst still allowing crafting.
body:
**Ender Eye Disabler does what the name suggests.**

Disables the use of the ender eye simple as.

But unlike most mods it doesn't disable obtaining the eye. or disable the actual portal itself
What it does is stops players from "Using" the eye. They cant throw it nor insert it into the portal.

Use /toggleeye to toggle the ender eye functionality

The mod includes two config options.

**eyeUseDisabled (Defaults to true)** disables the eye being used.

**denialMessage** Sends a message to the player when they try to insert the eye into the portal.

This is useful if you want a 'lore' reason for why its disabled.
